note: Pre-registered before v2 was trained (committed ahead of the v2 corpus). v1's held-out run exposed a failure mode -- a compound negation, 'X, not dialogue' -- so items_nocue.json can no longer serve as an untouched test for anything tuned after it. This set is new: 32 hand-written OCR lines (16 dialogue, 16 incidental), text only with no scene description, and a phrasing set that includes compound and complementary framings in wording that appears in neither the training nor the dev pools (build_zh.py asserts it). Labels are the author's; every item was chosen to be decidable from the text by a person.
